questions.question:
The graph below shows the variation of the maximum kinetic energy of the 
emitted photoelectron with the frequency of the incident radiation for a given 
metal. 
  
Which of the following gives the work function of the metal?

Assertion: The kinetic energy of photoelectrons emitted by a photosensitive surface depends 
upon the frequency of incident photon. 
Reason: The ejection of electrons from metallic surface is possible with frequency of incident  
photon below the threshold frequency.
